info.title: Sunmarke Lab Booking API
info.description: The API behind the website and the phone app. Times are stored in UTC and shown in Asia/Dubai. Errors are { error: { code, message } }. All availability decisions come from the rules engine (packages/rules).

bearer.description: Phone app token from POST /session with client: "app"

get.summary: Who is signed in ({ actor } or { actor: null }).

post.summary: Pilot sign-in by school email. Send client: "app" to get a 30-day Bearer token for the phone app. Replaced by Google / Microsoft sign-in when IT enables it.
Sign out (clears the cookie).

get.summary: Campuses the signed-in person can switch to.

post.summary: Switch campus (group admins and leadership only). Form posts redirect back.

get.summary: The booking grid: blocks × labs per day, each cell free, booked, closed or unavailable with the reason. Scoped to your campus.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: School-local date, YYYY-MM-DD (Asia/Dubai); up to 14 days after from

get.summary: Why a slot is blocked, and up to 4 free alternatives.

post.summary: Book a lab or carts. Runs the rules engine and the slot locks in one transaction.

409.description: Blocked: { ok: false, code, reason, suggestion?, canWaitlist, alternatives }

get.summary: One booking (yours, or any if you run it or are an admin).

patch.summary: Change the class details. To change the time, cancel and rebook.

post.summary: Cancel (or undo a cancel within a minute). Teachers are bound by the cut-off.
Rate a session, optionally reporting an equipment problem.
Mark attended or no-show.
Decline a booking with a reason (the teacher is emailed).
Move a booking to another in-charge.
Book a weekly series. preview: true returns what would be booked without booking.
Cancel every upcoming lesson in a series that is still outside the cut-off.
Join the waitlist for a taken slot.
Check in with the lab door QR code (opens 15 minutes before the start).
The booking assistant. Read-only: it answers with cards the person confirms through the normal booking routes.
Report an equipment problem; optionally take the lab out of use.
Close an issue (and reopen the lab).
Record in-charge leave; affected bookings are covered or flagged.
Import staff from CSV (name, email, department, role).

get.summary: The calendar invite attached to a sent email.

post.summary: Register this phone's push token.
Scheduled jobs. Needs Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET> (or an admin session).

parameters.name: tasks
parameters.description: Comma list: jobs, reminders, conflicts, offers, noshow, feedback
